_about: Home / wearable wellness readings. Thresholds are for HOME measurements and cite their guideline. They trigger 'tell your doctor' prompts, never a diagnosis.

bp.label: Blood pressure
bp.citation: ISH 2020 Global Hypertension Practice Guidelines (home BP hypertension threshold 135/85 mmHg)

glucose.label: Blood sugar (home meter)
glucose.citation: ADA Standards of Care: pre-meal capillary glucose target 80–130 mg/dL; below 70 mg/dL is hypoglycaemia

weight.label: Weight
weight.citation: WHO Asia-Pacific BMI cut-offs (overweight ≥23, obese ≥25); ≥5% unplanned weight loss in 6–12 months warrants review

heart_rate.label: Resting heart rate
heart_rate.citation: AHA: normal resting heart rate 60–100 bpm (well-trained adults may be lower)

spo2.label: Oxygen (SpO₂)
spo2.citation: Below 94% needs medical advice; below 90% is urgent (NHS / WHO pulse-oximetry guidance)

steps.label: Daily steps
steps.citation: Paluch AE et al. Lancet Public Health 2022: mortality benefit plateaus around 6,000–8,000 steps/day for adults over 60

sleep.label: Sleep
sleep.citation: AASM/SRS consensus: adults need 7 or more hours of sleep per night

water.label: Water
water.target: about 2–3 litres a day unless your doctor set a limit
water.citation: EFSA 2010 adequate intake (women 2.0 L, men 2.5 L total water/day); kidney or heart patients may have a fluid limit from their doctor

calories.label: Calories eaten
calories.target: depends on age, size and activity
calories.citation: ICMR-NIN Dietary Guidelines for Indians 2024 (energy needs vary by age, sex and activity)
